messages.subject: Correlate Errors in Lavaan
parts:
Hi there, relatively new to Lavaan here and wondering what the syntax is to correlate the errors of 2 variables together, rather than just correlating the variables themselves: 

What I am looking for is the very rightmost covariance (where d3 and d4 are error terms).














Many thanks!

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Correlate Errors in Lavaan
parts: Just use the same ~~ operator. If the variables are dependent, then this refers to residual correlation.

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Correlate Errors in Lavaan
parts: The variables themselves are correlated through the path model. Residual covariance is all that is left. If avariable were NOT dependent, then "residual covariance" and "covariance" would be the same thing.
